priority_method: Review order: eligible breakouts, blocked fresh breakouts, then waiting HH/HL setups nearest their trigger in ATR units. Late setups last. No forecast score or promise of profit.

data_audit.price_source: Yahoo adjusted daily history plus official NSE closing candles when ex-date and prior-close scale checks pass; exact official index OHLC fills missing benchmark sessions.
data_audit.latest_recheck: 200/200 complete prices; 200/200 rechecked for this session. Benchmark complete. Official Nifty Indices constituent CSV checked during this run.
data_audit.universe_source: Official Nifty Indices constituent CSV checked during this run.
data_audit.calendar_policy: Trading sessions require positive volume in at least 100 constituents; market-wide zero-volume holiday placeholders are excluded before pivots and ATR.
data_audit.date_policy: All observations after the requested date are excluded before indicators and pivots are calculated.

rules.entry: Fresh closing cross over latest confirmed high with two rising highs and lows. Market gate must pass. Next open within one signal ATR of close.
rules.sell: Close below confirmed low is an exit condition only for existing long holdings. It is not an overnight short recommendation.
rules.watch: Rising structure without a fresh breakout. The displayed one-ATR band below resistance is an orientation zone, not an entry signal.
rules.caution: Missing data, incomplete pivots, blocked fresh breakout or an already-passed breakout.
rules.avoid: No rising structure or failed price, liquidity or ATR screen; this does not mean the company is a bad investment.
rules.execution: These are dated scanner states, not portfolio orders. Actual fills, existing stops, time exits, earnings dates and allocation limits still matter.

status_definitions.BUY: Fresh qualifying breakout; next-session paper entry only.
status_definitions.SELL: Structure exit condition for an existing long position.
status_definitions.WATCH: HH/HL structure; wait for a closing breakout.
status_definitions.CAUTION: Data issue, blocked entry or missed fresh trigger.
status_definitions.AVOID: No qualifying HH/HL setup or failed entry screen.

limitations: End-of-day analysis through 2026-09-25; this is not an intraday feed.
No trading strategy has been forward validated. Classifications are research states.
Missing stock candles remain visible as CAUTION; incomplete prices never become new BUY entries.
Membership refresh and adjusted-price sources can be delayed; check the visible refresh status.
No earnings-calendar gate. Existing position stops and 10-session exits require your actual entry record.
There is no fixed profit target in the tested HH/HL rule; adding one would change the strategy.
